subject: WRITE statement
notes: SR18: 'The phrases ADVANCING PAGE and END-OF-PAGE shall not both be specified in a single WRITE statement.' (--check OK). RE-VERDICTED by kb/Work PB578: the END-OF-PAGE phrase is GR27 b)'s imperative-statement-1 (the AT phrase); SR19 ('If the END-OF-PAGE or the NOT END-OF-PAGE phrase is specified', --check OK 19)) and GR28 name the NOT END-OF-PAGE phrase separately, so the rule bars only the AT phrase. The earlier record read 'END-OF-PAGE' as the phrase GROUP and rejected AFTER PAGE NOT EOP (ws1pgneop) - legal source refused. Now: the AT phrase beside ADVANCING PAGE -> COBOL0861 whichever phrase is written first (Sr18_AdvancingPageWithEop_IsRejected, Sr18_AdvancingPageWithNotFirstEopPair_IsRejected, negative pb578-write-advancing-page-at-and-not-eop); a NOT-only phrase compiles and its imperative does not run (Sr18_AdvancingPageWithNotEopOnly_IsLegalAndTheEndOfPageConditionOccurs, 85/pb578_advancing_page_overflow_85). Determination: docs/CONFORMANCE.md §4 'WRITE ADVANCING PAGE on a logical page is a page overflow'.
